title: Lab - Storage classes
scenario: Provision volumes dynamically. This lab is a skeleton: the tasks name what to do and how to check it; work them on your own cluster and expand your notes as you go.
environment_setup:
# A three-node kind cluster is enough for this lab
cat <<'EOF' > kind-cka.yaml
kind: Cluster
apiVersion: kind.x-k8s.io/v1alpha4
name: cka
nodes:
  - role: control-plane
  - role: worker
  - role: worker
EOF
kind create cluster --config kind-cka.yaml
kubectl get nodes
cleanup:
kind delete cluster --name cka
rm -f kind-cka.yaml

tasks.title: Task 1 - List
tasks.instructions: Which StorageClasses exist, which provisioner does each use, and which is the default?

tasks.title: Task 2 - Claim
tasks.instructions: Create PVC local-pvc (500Mi, ReadWriteOnce) using the local-storage class. Why is it Pending?
tasks.solution:
kubectl create -f local-pvc.yaml
kubectl describe pvc local-pvc

tasks.title: Task 3 - Consume
tasks.instructions: Create Pod nginx mounting it at /var/www/html and watch the claim bind.
tasks.solution:
kubectl run nginx --image=nginx:alpine --dry-run=client -o yaml > p.yaml  # add the volume
kubectl apply -f p.yaml
